requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement contains two distinct functional actions ('add System-B' and 'allow System-C to subscribe') without a clear priority or dependency. Per Pohl §25.2, this concern-mixing is decomposed into two separate functional requirements to clarify execution order and scope.

source_fragments: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems
structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must add System-B to its downstream systems.
structuring_notes: Extracted the first functional action regarding System-B integration.

source_fragments: allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

fields.object: System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: Extracted the second functional action regarding System-C subscription. Separated from SR-01 to avoid confusion about whether adding System-B is a prerequisite for allowing System-C.
